subject: Consolidated follow-up: lock demo slot, confirm hosts & join link
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
To: Dana Williams <dana@medsync.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@healthops.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated follow-up: lock demo slot, confirm hosts & join link

Hi Dana & Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through HealthSync's ingestion patterns and the compliance constraints for PHI. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the demo:

- Recap: You want a 45-minute technical demo showing model routing, our KV caching for short-context workloads, and how Redwood Private would integrate with your VPC + KMS.
- Goals for the demo: confirm SSO flow, show latency profiles on committed capacity, and validate prefix-caching improvements on your sample dataset.

Proposed demo windows (PT):
1) Tue, Jun 20 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
2) Wed, Jun 21 — 1:00–1:45 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works best? Also confirm these attendees so we can finalize hosts:
- From HealthSync: Dana Williams (Product), Tom Li (Platform) — please add anyone from Security if they want to join the SSO/Q&A.
- From Redwood: Sean Gallagher (Sales lead, will own the agenda), Monica Patel (Solutions, will send calendar invite), Aditya Rao (Platform engineer, will lead the SSO segment).

Preferences: Zoom (preferred) or Google Meet? If Zoom, do you prefer we generate the bridge or do you want to provide your own?

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and an initial SSO question list (prelim-sso-questions.pdf) for review. If you confirm a slot, Monica will share the calendar invite + bridge and we will use the MAP as the playbook.

Thanks — feel free to reply with the preferred slot and any extra attendees to add.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.g@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), prelim-sso-questions.pdf (pdf)

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. Both slots look reasonable; if we have to pick one now, go with Tue, Jun 20 at 10:00 AM PT. Zoom please and please create the bridge (that works better for our Security folks).

Two quick notes:
- I'll invite our security lead, Priya K., to the invite (SSO + data handling will be her focus).
- We'll circulate a short data sample ahead of time (CSV) — Tom will send that by Monday.

On the SSO questions: I've skimmed the PDF and we have a couple of technical clarifications; Aditya can ping me offline if helpful.

Looking forward — Dana
Dana Williams

Monica / Aditya — Dana picked Tue, Jun 20 10:00 AM PT and asked us to generate the Zoom bridge. Please action the following: 

- Monica: please create the calendar invite for 2028-06-20 10:00–10:45 AM PT, include Dana, Tom, and Priya K. (Dana will forward their calendar address). Add the MAP and SSO question PDF to the invite, and include the Zoom link in the body. Mark the invite as: "HealthSync — Redwood technical demo (SSO + perf)".
- Aditya: prep a short SSO checklist (5 bullets) you can run through during the demo and be ready for the security Q&A. I'll introduce you during the session.

I'll draft the agenda below and send any prep notes to Dana this afternoon. If either of you see conflicts, let me know.

--Sean
